tool_args.rationale: The archived two-layer siphon with a positive square-root branch reproduces all five pilot values to rounding precision. Its fitted sink strength is 0.709, within the archive range. Submit this three-coefficient law for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Siphon without a branch or with a linear branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both meet the tolerance on the pilot, but leave RMSE of about 0.022 and 0.010, respectively, versus about 3e-8 for the square-root branch.
The five rows already distinguish the archive branch forms at the reported measurement precision.
The stationary siphon explains all five observations at the target horizon; the pilot gives no residual evidence that warrants fitting a memory ODE.
